What are the Admissions Requirements for All Certificates?

  1. Submit the online application form. Application is available online only. The application can be renewed from the fall semester to the spring semester of the same academic year only by sending an email to enrolauc@aucegypt.edu. A new application should be submitted for a new academic year. Applications submitted after the set deadlines will be considered according to the availability of places.
  2. Check that you have submitted all required documents by the set deadlines. Your application and a final admission decision will be pending the submission of all these documents. Upload all required documents through the online portal, as they are not considered via email.

       Important Notes:

  • The personal statement should be the applicant’s original work, as they will be checked for plagiarism.
  • Two recommendation letters are mandatory; applicants should include the email addresses of their recommender in the admission application as instructed, as s/he will automatically receive an email with instructions to submit their recommendation letters directly to AUC. Recommendation letters should be written by high school teachers and/or counselors.

What Are the English Language Admission Requirements? 

Check that you have fulfilled all the University’s language requirements below:

  • All new undergraduate students applying as degree and non-degree students must provide evidence of academic English proficiency with the admission application. The University does not exempt applicants from this requirement solely on the basis of citizenship or graduation from an English-medium secondary school. 
  • English placement depends on your International TOEFL, Academic IELTS or Duolingo test scores.
  • All tests should be completed no more than two years prior to the first day of the semester applied for. 
  • Electronic results of the International TOEFL and Duolingo exams have to be directly sent to the admissions office. The AUC code for sending TOEFL scores is 0903. This is in addition to the copy uploaded along with the rest of the admission credentials.  For IELTS scores, a copy of the academic IELTS including the TRF number should be uploaded along with the rest of the admission credentials. 
  • Check the cut-off scores and placement levels.
  • TOEFL "MyBest Scores" is accepted.
  • IELTS "One Skill Retake" is considered.
  • Students who believe their placement in the ELI is not appropriate for their level of English proficiency are encouraged to retake the English placement exam. AUC does not offer “exemption” exams of any kind.
  • Applicants may submit an improved English placement test score to the University. The deadline to submit improved English placement test scores is the last working day before the start date of the semester at 4 pm Cairo Local Time. Scores submitted after this deadline will not be considered. For exact dates, check the AUC academic calendar. 
  • AUC accepts only official test score documents. Text messages from test centers will not be considered.

Check more information about language requirements.

What Are the Admission Requirements for Declaring a Major Upon Admission?

Applicants interested in majors offered by the School of Sciences and Engineering and the Onsi Sawiris School of Business  may be considered for major declaration provided that they meet the general undergraduate admission requirements in addition to any program-specific criteria.

  • Check the admission requirements for the School of Sciences and Engineering Programs.
  • Check the admission requirements for the Onsi Sawiris School of Business Programs (Effective Fall 2027)

Important Note:

These are the minimum requirements to apply. Acceptance is based on the availability of places.


What Are the Requirements for My Secondary School Certificate?

Admission requirements vary depending on the secondary school certificate. Review the requirements for your certificate type to understand the academic qualifications, subject requirements, and supporting documents needed for admission to AUC. If your certificate is not included, email the Office of Enrollment, Admissions and Student Service Center before submitting the admission application form.
